claims.text: Many reviewers say the mask visibly removes blackheads and leaves skin clearer, softer, and smoother after use.
Several reviewers report the product does not work and removes no blackheads at all.
Reviewers note it must be applied in a thick layer and allowed to dry fully to peel off properly.
Some reviewers say it did little for their own blackheads, though it worked for others or was still a decent product.
Reviewers mention the tube provides multiple uses (roughly three to five or more).
